paragraphs: HR and GeM portal consulting for small and medium organisations.
Kanjay Consulting works with businesses on their people, HR processes and GeM seller requirements. Our HR support is available globally; our GeM consulting supports sellers across India.
Our areas of work
HR · Global support
HR support for employers, with recruitment support also available to candidates.
GeM · Sellers across India
Guidance on seller activities within the Government e-Marketplace portal.
Candidate enquiries: hr@kanjayconsulting.com.
How we work
We work with clients through approaches agreed around their business needs.
For HR work, that can include reviewing records and processes, coordinating recruitment, and working with payroll inputs and documentation.
For GeM sellers, our work includes document coordination, reviewing bid requirements, portal submissions and follow-ups.
These are the practical activities behind our consulting services.
Our core values
We see trust as the foundation of effective communication and client relationships.
We believe in a commitment to quality in the work we do.
Our focus is on back-office support and long-term relationships with our clients.
Speak with us about HR support or GeM seller consulting.
